summary.business_type: Independent media / publisher (Vespa community content + sponsorship proposal pages)
top_findings: Cloudflare edge robots.txt blocks GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, meta-externalagent — defeats AI Overviews/ChatGPT/Perplexity visibility
Hero videos are oversized (19MB, 5.8MB, 1.2MB) — biggest Core Web Vitals / LCP risk
/vw-yogyakarta/ missing from sitemap.xml on both local and live site
Meta descriptions on / and /en/ exceed ~160 char snippet limit
Image lazy-loading inconsistent (3/13 on main pages, 0/8 and 0/7 on proposal pages)
quick_wins: Trim meta descriptions to <=160 chars on / and /en/
Decide intentionally on Cloudflare AI-crawler block (allow Google-Extended + GPTBot if GEO matters)
Compress/transcode the two large hero videos

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Canonical URLs correct and self-referencing on all pages
HTTPS via Cloudflare, x-content-type-options and referrer-policy headers present

findings.title: Cloudflare-managed robots.txt blocks AI crawlers
findings.description: Live robots.txt has a Cloudflare-injected block (Disallow: / for GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, meta-externalagent) not present in the local repo file — injected at the Cloudflare edge.
findings.recommendation: Confirm intentional; if GEO/AI citations matter, allow Google-Extended and GPTBot at minimum.

findings.title: /vw-yogyakarta/ missing from sitemap.xml
findings.description: Confirmed on both local file and live sitemap.xml; only /, /en/, /60s-yogyakarta/ listed.
findings.recommendation: Add a <url> entry matching the 60s-yogyakarta pattern.

findings.title: No HSTS / CSP headers
findings.description: Live response missing Strict-Transport-Security and Content-Security-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add via Cloudflare Transform Rules or origin config.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Optional convention, low priority given the robots.txt AI-crawler block already limits AI bot access.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Distinct, purpose-specific content per page, no thin/duplicate boilerplate
Concrete, specific copy rather than generic filler

findings.title: No visible author/byline or publish date
findings.description: No author bios or dated posts detected on the homepage, relevant for E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add author + date if a blog/article section is planned.

findings.title: Full readability/word-count scan not performed
findings.description: This pass analyzed static HTML directly rather than rendering pages; deep content-quality scoring wasn't run.
findings.recommendation: Follow up with a dedicated content-quality pass if deeper E-E-A-T scoring is wanted.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 per page on all 4 pages
Unique titles and descriptions per page

findings.title: Meta descriptions exceed ~160 char display limit on / and /en/
findings.recommendation: Trim to <=160 characters, front-load the value proposition.

findings.title: Homepage titles are short and brand-only
findings.description: Titles don't include a descriptive keyword phrase beyond the brand name.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a keyword-rich phrase, balanced against brand-recognition needs.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema present and valid on / and /en/
Event schema present on both proposal pages
All JSON-LD blocks parse as valid JSON

findings.title: Event schema field completeness not fully validated
findings.description: Required fields for Event rich results (startDate, location, offers/organizer) weren't individually verified in this pass.
findings.recommendation: Run Google's Rich Results Test on both proposal pages.

findings.title: No WebSite schema with SearchAction
findings.description: Missing sitelinks search box eligibility markup.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Site is shallow, so impact is minor.

findings.title: Oversized hero videos
findings.description: vespa_kegiatanok.mp4 (19MB), jsp_landscape.mp4 (5.8MB), hero-bg.mp4 (1.2MB) used as autoplaying backgrounds; likely the single biggest LCP/load-time problem.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode to <3MB, add poster image, preload="none" or "metadata", consider static image fallback on mobile.

findings.title: Several large unoptimized JPG/PNG images
findings.description: vespa_ss90.png (624KB), jamnas_poster.jpg (600KB), multiple vw-yogyakarta page images (240-370KB each), no WebP/AVIF found.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF with fallback, target <150KB for hero-adjacent images.

findings.title: Static asset caching not verified
findings.description: HTML cache-control looks correct; static asset (image/video/font) caching wasn't checked in this pass.
findings.recommendation: Verify long max-age + immutable caching via Cloudflare Page Rules.

findings.title: AI crawlers blocked at the Cloudflare edge
findings.description: Content-Signal ai-train=no plus explicit Disallow for GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, CCBot, Bytespider makes the site structurally invisible to ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Meta AI, and Claude web tools.
findings.recommendation: This is a deliberate tradeoff to make consciously: allow Google-Extended and GPTBot if AI-driven discovery/lead-gen matters; keep blocking pure training bots (CCBot, Bytespider) if content protection is the priority.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt-text coverage across all 4 pages (13, 13, 8, 7 images respectively)

findings.title: Inconsistent lazy-loading
findings.description: Only 3/13 images lazy-loaded on main pages; 0/8 and 0/7 on proposal pages.
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" to all below-the-fold images.

findings.title: No modern image formats detected
findings.description: All images checked are .jpg/.png; no .webp/.avif variants found.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP with fallback or use <picture> with AVIF/WebP sources.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Decide on the Cloudflare AI-crawler block (allow Google-Extended + GPTBot if GEO matters)
Compress hero videos (19MB and 5.8MB files) to <3MB with poster images

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Trim meta descriptions on / and /en/ to <=160 chars
Add loading="lazy" to all below-the-fold images across all 4 pages
Convert large JPG/PNG assets to WebP/AVIF
Validate Event schema fields via Google Rich Results Test

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add author attribution + publish dates for planned content/blog
Revisit homepage title for keyword coverage

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console + GA4 (G-6LLXWQ6MMM already installed) for real field data
Re-run this audit after Phase 1-2 fixes to confirm score improvement
Add HSTS/CSP headers via Cloudflare Transform Rules
